visual_identity.core_identity: A tall, long-armed goblinoid ambusher with controlled shaggy hair and unmistakably goblinoid facial structure. It is humanoid and predatory, never ape-like, sasquatch-like, bear-like, or a generic furry brute.
visual_identity.silhouette: Tall rangy humanoid, narrow waist, long arms reaching below the hips, large hands, pointed ears, slightly stooped but fully bipedal stance. Hair creates a rough outline around head, shoulders, back, and forearms without turning the whole body into a fur mass.
visual_identity.head_features: Clearly goblinoid head: pointed ears, angular cheek planes, low brow, small watchful eyes, broad projecting goblinoid nose and short mouth line. No flat primate muzzle, gorilla brow block, bear muzzle, or rounded ape skull.
visual_identity.body_shape: Long-limbed powerful humanoid with a narrower torso than a gorilla or ogre, long forearms, large hands, and stable bipedal weight-bearing legs. Muscular but not barrel-chested or bodybuilder-thick.
visual_identity.surface: Shaggy hair is selective and directional on head, shoulders, upper back, forearms, and outer legs. Chest, face, hands, feet, and major anatomy stay open and readable for coloring.
must_keep: very long arms and large hands
selective shaggy hair rather than full-body fur
must_avoid: bear muzzle or rounded bear ears

accuracy_checks: face reads goblinoid before furry brute
nose projects as goblinoid rather than flat primate muzzle
arms are visibly long without gorilla proportions
torso stays humanoid and rangy rather than barrel-chested
fur is selective and does not hide anatomy
pose is stably supported by the environment

known_failure_modes.symptom: face or torso reads as gorilla, ape-man, or primate
known_failure_modes.correction: remove primate muzzle and brow block, narrow the torso, restore pointed ears, angular goblinoid cheeks, projecting goblinoid nose, and upright humanoid leg proportions

known_failure_modes.symptom: creature reads as Bigfoot or a full-body furry humanoid
known_failure_modes.correction: reduce fur coverage to selective patches and expose clean chest, face, hands, feet, and long-limbed goblinoid anatomy
remove bear muzzle and rounded ears; restore pointed ears, angular facial planes, and goblinoid nose

known_failure_modes.symptom: body becomes a generic hulking bodybuilder
known_failure_modes.correction: narrow the waist and chest, lengthen the arms, keep muscle simple, and restore stealthy goblinoid proportions

known_failure_modes.symptom: feet do not visibly contact a support surface
known_failure_modes.correction: place both feet or another clear support point against the environment and use a stable natural coloring pose
